architect_intent.statement: Demonstrate that Kalaxy3/SAGE can take a meaningful first-party change from stakeholder intent through portable build, exact artifact promotion, live runtime verification, and learning without depending on a particular development machine or workflow engine.

stakeholder_concerns: runtime readiness sufficient for the intended proof

experience_inventory_queries.question: What accumulated experience can SAGE surface around building once and promoting the same exact artifact?
experience_inventory_queries.retrieval_request: Retrieve repository engineering experience about immutable artifact promotion without rebuild, exact OCI digest identity, multi-architecture artifact provenance, target publication, executor neutrality, and SAGE-ACTION-20260815-002. Preserve validated evidence, lessons, failures, improvement actions, exact applicable facts, and provenance.
experience_inventory_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Potential direct experience with reproducible portable delivery; transferability still requires contextual judgment.

experience_inventory_queries.question: What accumulated experience can SAGE surface around recovery when Git or GitHub advances independently?
experience_inventory_queries.retrieval_request: Retrieve repository engineering experience about checkpoint promotion recovery, observed-state reconciliation, GitHub pull requests, externally advanced Git state, stale continuation boundaries, operator intervention, mutation replay, and semantic closeout.
experience_inventory_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Potential experience in reducing stale workflow assumptions and unnecessary operator intervention.

experience_inventory_queries.question: What accumulated experience can SAGE surface around externally reachable zero-trust runtime behavior?
experience_inventory_queries.retrieval_request: Retrieve repository engineering experience about Kalaxy3 zero-trust runtime validation, Cloudflare access, MFA, negative-access proof, externally reachable runtime, security boundary verification, and sage.donb4iu.com.
experience_inventory_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Potential direct runtime/security experience; present readiness remains a separate question.

experience_inventory_queries.question: What accumulated experience can SAGE surface around objective-sized execution and learning?
experience_inventory_queries.retrieval_request: Retrieve repository engineering experience about objective execution, objective-sized planning, approval atomicity, correction versus replan, path critic observations, causal evidence, operator round trips, and learning from completed objective episodes.
experience_inventory_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Potential experience with governed execution and reusable learning.

intent_experience_queries.question: Which accumulated experience may apply to portable build and exact promotion for this intent?
intent_experience_queries.retrieval_request: Retrieve repository engineering experience relevant to a strategic objective requiring portable build, immutable exact OCI artifact promotion without rebuild, executor neutrality, multi-architecture provenance, target digest verification, and runtime delivery.
intent_experience_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Direct or analogous delivery experience may transfer, but applicability is not inferred from retrieval.

intent_experience_queries.question: Which accumulated experience may apply to live zero-trust verification for this intent?
intent_experience_queries.retrieval_request: Retrieve repository engineering experience relevant to live zero-trust runtime verification, Cloudflare access, MFA, negative-access validation, external user access, runtime health, and security evidence.
intent_experience_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Runtime/security experience may transfer; current cluster readiness still requires current evidence.

intent_experience_queries.question: Which accumulated experience may apply to low-intervention recovery for this intent?
intent_experience_queries.retrieval_request: Retrieve repository engineering experience relevant to recovery with low operator intervention, observed external state, checkpoint promotion, GitHub continuation, mutation replay avoidance, correction versus replan, and operator round-trip reduction.
intent_experience_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Recovery experience may help reduce unnecessary human intervention without prescribing the current path.

llm_innovations.proposal: Use a meaningful first-party SAGE experience change as the end-to-end workload rather than inventing a disposable demonstration application.
llm_innovations.why: Would make delivery proof and stakeholder-visible value part of the same episode.

llm_innovations.proposal: Before committing to the full live episode, run a bounded readiness check that asks only whether the current cluster and delivery path can support the intended proof.
llm_innovations.why: High information gain if runtime readiness is uncertain; avoids broad infrastructure hardening without evidence.

llm_innovations.proposal: Treat newly discovered infrastructure deficiency as relevant only when it blocks or materially risks the stakeholder outcome.
llm_innovations.why: Preserves the 80/20 objective rather than turning the proof into a cluster modernization project.

unresolved_questions: Is the current Kalaxy3 cluster sufficiently ready to host the intended live proof without unrelated hardening?
Which first-party change creates enough stakeholder-visible value to make the end-to-end proof meaningful?
Which retrieved experience is directly transferable versus analogous to this exact objective?
Which runtime and objective-episode evidence exists only on particular executors and is therefore unavailable to canonical repository retrieval?

human_decisions.decision: Choose whether to buy a small amount of current cluster/readiness information before authorizing the full end-to-end episode.
Choose the meaningful first-party workload/change whose stakeholder value justifies the end-to-end proof.

tactical_options.expected_stakeholder_value: Reduces uncertainty about whether the live proof is currently feasible.
tactical_options.risk: May reveal a genuine blocker that changes the next objective.

tactical_options.expected_stakeholder_value: Produces the strongest direct proof if current infrastructure is already sufficient.
tactical_options.risk: Could mix product proof with avoidable infrastructure diagnosis if readiness is weaker than assumed.
High chance of solving infrastructure concerns that are not material blockers to the intended proof.
